text:
Alex S.: HelixCorp greenlit a 2-week POC. Flow they want: streaming SDK -> tool/function calls (moderation) -> structured JSON output for reranking. Demo requested Tue 10am PT. Need SE + Eng + Sec + Finance input.

Priya (SE): I can run the demo playbook. Quick: what’s their latency SLO and typical token distribution? Do they need VPC/on-prem trial or is hosted ok for the first run?

Mateo (Eng): Heads-up: they said some requests will be ~25-30k tokens. They want tail latency ~<250ms for interactive paths. Also their corp proxy kills long SSE connections. We should plan a websocket fallback and short heartbeat.

Zora (Security): From the questionnaire: they require SAML SSO + customer-managed KMS + SOC2 evidence. Dedicated/Private covers SAML+KMS; hosted can work if they accept our SOC2 attestation copy. Ask them for exact fields on retention & export controls.

Roxanne (Finance): Ballpark for trial: 2-week Dedicated style trial (1x A10G-equivalent peak, about 4-6 vGPU-days) -> offer $7k trial credit and hands-on support. Production Dedicated baseline for their load starts ~ $18k/mo. Function/tool call pricing: $0.002 per call + per-token inference pricing.

Priya (SE): Mateo, can you drop a minimal handshake + websocket fallback example and a short structured-output schema we can hand to their infra/security teams? Need a curl snippet + tiny node example.

Mateo (Eng): Sure — keep ephemeral creds TTL short for demo. Example handshake (POST to start streaming):

```
# curl handshake (prefer SSE, fallback to websocket)
curl -X POST https://inference.redwood.ai/v1/streams/start
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <EPHEMERAL>"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"rwd-stream-4b","max_tokens":8192,"interactive":true,"prefer":"sse;fallback=websocket"}'
```

Mateo (Eng): If proxy drops SSE, client should open a websocket to /v1/streams/ws with same auth header. Quick websocket client (node):

```js
// ws fallback example (node)
const ws = new WebSocket('wss://inference.redwood.ai/v1/streams/ws', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer <EPHEMERAL>' } });
ws.on('open', () => { ws.send(JSON.stringify({ model: 'rwd-stream-4b', max_tokens: 8192 })); });
ws.on('message', (m) => console.log('evt', m));
// heartbeat every 15s
setInterval(() => ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'heartbeat' })), 15000);
```

Mateo (Eng): Example streaming event when assistant invokes the moderation tool:

```
event: message
data: {"role":"assistant","type":"tool.call","tool":"content_moderation","args":{"text":"..."},"trace_id":"trc-helix-001"}
```

Mateo (Eng): Structured output schema sample (JSON Schema as string in the response content):

```json
{"choices":[{"index":0,"message":{"content":{"type":"structured","schema":"{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{\"safety\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"category\":{\"type\":\"string\"},\"score\":{\"type\":\"number\"}}}","value":{"safety":"allowed","category":"medical","score":0.02}}}]}
```

Priya (SE): Nice. For client guidance: recommend window=6 concurrent in-flight tokens, heartbeat=15s, reconnect with exponential backoff + full jitter. For server: suggest prefix KV cache for repeated docs and auto-batch size=24 to keep p50 low.

Roxanne (Finance): For Helix's moderation-heavy workload, show them example math: if they do 5k turns/day with avg 200 tokens/turn -> token cost + 5k * $0.002 = $10/day in tool-call fees. Include monthly extrapolation in deck.

integrations-bot: ephemeral token issued (valid 02:00:00) — token id: tok-helix-2026-01 (demo only) :white_check_mark:

Alex S.: Schedule confirmed Tue 10am PT. Priya, Mateo, Zora please attend. Helix asked we push a 10k-token doc during demo and trigger moderation + structured output. Confirm readiness by Mon EOD.

Priya (SE): Confirmed. I'll assemble a 1-page runbook (ephemeral creds flow, handshake + ws fallback, run steps for behind-proxy, escalation contacts, pricing bullet) and send to the Helix contact.

Mateo (Eng): I'll build a tiny docker with websocket fallback + simple load script to exercise a 10k doc (image: docker.pkg.redwood/helix-demo:latest). Will post run instructions and link by Mon.

Zora (Security): I'll email Helix sec lead for SAML metadata and KMS key policy snippet. Also ask whether they want audit-log delivery to their SIEM (we support syslog/HTTP collector on Dedicated/Private).

Alex S.: Thanks all — priority. If proxy or token-rate issues show up during smoke, ping me and we'll escalate to eng-sre. :thumbsup:
